estimates.assumptions: 14 oz jar ≈ 400 g total weight; typical canned enchilada sauce (red, mild) at ~70 kcal/100 g, ~2 g protein/100 g, ~3 g fat/100 g; entire jar used in recipe.
3 US cups shredded Monterey Jack ≈ 340 g; standard values ~388 kcal/100 g, ~22 g protein/100 g, ~32 g fat/100 g; entire amount layered into casserole.
6 standard 6-inch corn tortillas ≈ 240 g total (≈40 g each); typical values ~150 kcal/100 g, ~3.7 g protein/100 g, ~1.9 g fat/100 g; all 6 used in layers.

2 raw boneless skinless chicken breasts ≈ 400 g total edible portion (≈200 g each, typical medium size); values ~110 kcal/100 g, ~20.5 g protein/100 g, ~2.5 g fat/100 g; fully cooked in sauce, all meat shredded and used (no bones/skin).
